title: What the fixer did with each finding it was given
description: Bookkeeping, not proof. Every outcome here is re-checked by the reviewer that raised the finding.

outcomes.description: Exactly one entry per finding supplied. A missing entry ends the pull request.

outcome.description: fixed means the defect is gone by the repair the finding proposed, or by any repair where it proposed none; fixed-differently means the finding was right and the defect is gone, but the repair departs from the one the finding proposed. wont-fix means the finding is wrong or the repair is a decision for a person; failed means the repair was attempted and did not work.

note.description: What changed, or why nothing did.

notes.description: Anything the reviewer re-checking this work needs and cannot read from the diff.
